basic_details.job_title: AJNIFM Head, Defence Finance and Economics Research Centre Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management (AJNIFM), Faridabad, has invited applications for one post of Head, Defence Finance and Economics Research Centre, under the CGDA-AJNIFM Research Programme, on a contractual basis. The consolidated pay is Rs. 1,50,000 per month (maximum). The post is for former officers of IDAS, Central Government, Autonomous Bodies or PSUs (Level 16 and above or equivalent) with a minimum of 25 to 30 years' experience in Defence Finance related policies and implementation. Applications in the Annexure format must reach [email protected] on or before 04 D

age_limit.details: Maximum age of less than 70 years. The notice prints no date for counting age. The notice does not print a separate educational qualification; candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the format given in the Annexure (the Application Form on page 2 of the notice). It asks for personal information, academic qualifications, professional qualifications or certifications, and relevant experience, and ends with a signed declaration.

In the experience section, give total experience in years with the organisations worked with, year-wise details of similar assignments in the last 3 years, and experience with National/International Bodies.
Attach relevant documents such as proof of work experience and proof of age.
Email the application to [email protected]. It should reach on or before 04-12-2026.
The notice says detailed information on applying is available on the Institute's website, www.ajnifm.ac.in.
important_instructions: The application must reach the email address on or before 04-12-2026. The application form declaration states that false information makes the applicant liable for disqualification or termination at any stage. The form asks for "Post Applied For" to be written on it.

Head, Defence Finance and Economics Research Centre
Minimum 25 to 30 years' experience in Defence Finance related policies and implementation

content_sections.heading: About AJNIFM
content_sections.text: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management is located at Sector-48, Pali Road, Faridabad. Its application form describes it as an Institute of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. The advertised post is under the CGDA-AJNIFM Research Programme, a collaborative research initiative with the Controller General of Defence Accounts, Ministry of Defence.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification, as printed: Former Officers of IDAS/Central Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs (Level 16 and above or equivalent). Professional experience, as printed: Minimum 25 to 30 years' experience in Defence Finance related policies and implementation. Prior work experience with Defence Ministry, Armed Forces, Defence Think Tanks in Defence Budgeting, Delegation of Financial Powers, Audit Frameworks, Performance Evaluation Systems and Policy Formulation, and implementation. Background of Defence Budgeting Cycles, Revenue/Capital Heads, and outcome based Budgeting, Financial Rules, Audit Frameworks, and Performance Evaluation Systems. Demonstrate leadership, academic/research guidance and departmental administration experience. Proven ability to manage research Centre operations, budgets, and staff. Ability to prepare policy briefs, research papers, analytical reports, cost-benefit analysis. Strong track record in institutional collaboration and partnership building. Maximum age of less than 70 years. The notice prints no date for counting age. The notice does not print a separate educational qualification; candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice gives the consolidated pay per month (maximum) as Rs.1,50,000/-. The engagement is on a contractual basis under the CGDA-AJNIFM Research Programme. The notice does not mention the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AJNIFM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the format given in the Annexure (the Application Form on page 2 of the notice). It asks for personal information, academic qualifications, professional qualifications or certifications, and relevant experience, and ends with a signed declaration. In the experience section, give total experience in years with the organisations worked with, year-wise details of similar assignments in the last 3 years, and experience with National/International Bodies. Attach relevant documents such as proof of work experience and proof of age. Email the application to [email protected] . It should reach on or before 04-12-2026. The notice says detailed information on applying is available on the Institute's website, www.ajnifm.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application must reach the email address on or before 04-12-2026. The application form declaration states that false information makes the applicant liable for disqualification or termination at any stage. The form asks for "Post Applied For" to be written on it.
